verdict.rationale: Viam's RDK source is public on GitHub: the repo describes SDKs that interface with the RDK and documents running the server from source with `go run ./web/cmd/server`. That shows the code is readable, but nothing in the evidence names an open-source license. One community commenter was unsure how much of Viam is actually open source; that is an open question, not a contradiction. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license for the RDK, evidence of which parts (cloud app, registry, SDKs) are open versus proprietary, independent confirmation of the licensing terms.
